answer: Reef-shaped arrival gating. Rule: each new agent identity must place its first N transactions within a wristwatch-like envelope, neither clumped below a floor nor spread past a ceiling, and a jade token is issued only when inter-arrival variance falls inside the licensed band. Ferrous clock attestations seal each arrival, so replay is detectable. Attackers pay per identity: sustaining many bots in band requires real scheduling jitter and uptime, roughly ten times the compute of burst registration, plus forfeited jade tokens on every miss.
